LanguageData.Binguin_FieldCombatBionicEye.label: Field combat bionic eye
LanguageData.Binguin_FieldCombatBionicEye.description: An installed field combat bionic eye. Its lens is sheathed in a frostproof crystal film, and the meteorological compensation array at its intake corrects in real time the distortion in imaging caused by rain, snow, sandstorms and thick fog, so that however foul the weather, the shooter's hit chance is the same as in clear skies. The extra optical gain also raises the wearer's shooting accuracy by one step.
LanguageData.Binguin_BoardSpeed.label: Board dash
LanguageData.Binguin_BoardSpeed.description: The extra mobility granted by a penguin board, making every step as light as a glide over ice.
LanguageData.Binguin_SlideImmunity.label: Sliding
LanguageData.Binguin_SlideImmunity.description: Sliding at high speed, swift as lightning, and impossible for enemies to hit.
LanguageData.Binguin_WasteToxemia.label: waste toxemia
LanguageData.Binguin_WasteToxemia.description: Heavy metals and organic poisons in toxic waste are rapidly destroying the blood. Wounds will not stop bleeding, consciousness falls steadily with blood loss, and death follows within hours.
LanguageData.Binguin_IceBurst.label: ice burst
LanguageData.Binguin_IceBurst.description: Freezing energy gathering within the body. At 100%, the cold energy abruptly freezes and shatters one body part.
